name: Priya S.
quote: Made one for my best friend’s 28th. Just added her name, two photos from our Goa trip and a short voice note. She opened it on WhatsApp and immediately called me crying (happy tears). Said it felt more personal than any gift she’d received in years.

name: Arjun M.
quote: Propose karne se pehle bahut nervous tha. Proposal template use kiya, apne words likhe, 3 memories aur ek photo daali. Link bheja. Usne page complete karne se pehle hi haan bol diya. Still keeps the link saved. Best decision ever.

name: Sneha R.
quote: Our 4th anniversary. Made a little storybook of our years together with photos and short notes for each year. He opened it at midnight and just sat quiet for a while. Later said this is the most thoughtful thing I’ve ever done. Coming from him, that meant a lot.

name: Rahul K.
quote: Badi wali galti ho gayi thi. Proper se sorry kaise bolun samajh nahi aa raha tha. Apology gift banaya with a sincere note. She replied within an hour and we actually talked properly after that. Felt better than a hundred texts.

name: Ananya T.
quote: Made one for my mum. She doesn’t usually get emotional about digital things, but she kept going back to the candle part and the memories. Called me the next morning just to say thank you again. Completely worth it.

name: Vikram J.
quote: Long distance is tough. Sent this when I couldn’t visit for two months. She said it felt like a paper hug. Simple but she still opens it sometimes when she misses me.

name: Meera P.
quote: College roommate ko thank you bolna tha jo rough semester mein help ki thi. Chhota sa note aur ek photo daala. Usne reply kiya ‘aaj iski zarurat thi’. Sometimes the small things hit the hardest.

name: Karthik N.
quote: Chhoti behen ke liye banaya. Silly photos, mera bekaar sa singing voice note aur short message. Usne candles light karte hue video bheji, has rahi thi. Parents also saw it and said it was the cutest gift she’s received.

name: Divya L.
quote: No special occasion, just because. Wrote a few reasons I love him and added two photos. He opened it during lunch break at work and texted ‘you’re not allowed to make me soft in office’. Still makes me smile.

name: Aisha F.
quote: Cousin cleared her UPSC. Made a little spotlight gift for her. She shared the link in the family group and everyone kept reacting. Felt good to celebrate her properly even though I couldn’t be there.

name: Rohan D.
quote: Used it for our first anniversary. Added the memory of how we met and a couple of photos. She said the way it slowly opens feels special, not like another WhatsApp forward. We’ve already decided to make one every year.

name: Neha V.
quote: Not perfect, but honest. Wrote a proper apology and left space for her to reply. She did reply and we sorted things out. Didn’t feel like a text argument, more like an actual conversation.
